CVE-2018-20796 affects glibc POSIX regcomp() on crafted backreference expressions. The Beam Go SDK boot container executes Go binaries that use Go's standard library regexp package rather than glibc regcomp().

Disputed upstream glibc issue in pthread stack guard sizing. The Beam Go SDK harness runs on the Go runtime scheduler (goroutines) and does not rely on glibc pthread guard-page allocation for untrusted native code.
Disputed upstream glibc ldd utility issue when inspecting untrusted ELF binaries. The Beam Go SDK harness never invokes ldd at runtime.
Disputed upstream glibc ASLR commentary. Not reachable as a runtime vulnerability in the Beam Go SDK container.
Disputed upstream glibc ptmalloc heap address predictability report. The Beam Go SDK harness uses the Go runtime memory allocator.

CVE-2019-9192 is a disputed stack-consumption issue in the POSIX regex compiler regcomp() in GNU C Library when compiling untrusted regular expressions. The Apache Beam Go SDK boot binary (/opt/apache/beam/boot) uses Go's native RE2 regexp package and does not invoke glibc regcomp().
